title: Hypernetwork-Conditioned WENO5 Conservative-Form CNNs for One-Dimensional Conservation Laws
summary: We study a conservative data-driven discretization for one-dimensional hyperbolic conservation laws based on the classical fifth-order WENO finite-volume scheme and a hypernetwork architecture. In the proposed Hyper--WENO5 Conservative-Form Convolutional Neural Network (Hyper--CFCNN), a lightweight target network predicts the nonlinear WENO weights on each stencil, while a hypernetwork generates the target-network parameters from problem metadata, including the mesh spacing, mesh layout, and coarse descriptors of the initial condition.
